scope: PostgreSQL repository operations and conditional transitions only; no S3 I/O, queue publishing, worker activation or HTTP endpoints.

implementation.module: VideosPersistenceModule registers and exports both repositories; one injected DataSource and transactional EntityManager per atomic operation.
implementation.ownership: Private reads/updates scope video id to the owning channel; internal session read explicitly selects upload_id; public slug lookup requires ready.
implementation.slug: Cryptographically generated 24-character lowercase hex; retry only SQLSTATE 23505 on UQ_videos_slug; fixed SAVEPOINT/ROLLBACK TO/RELEASE around each attempt; maximum five attempts; exhausted collision maps to inherited DomainException VIDEO_ID_GENERATION_FAILED / 503.
implementation.upload_claims: Row-locked draft claims, UUID tokens and database-clock deadlines. Recovery reports previousOperation and requiresReconciliation; expired session alone does not discard a possibly completed object. Session attachment/completion/failure/release require owning channel, current token and live operation deadline.
implementation.atomic_completion: draft-to-processing update, persisted actual size equal to declared, and one outbox insert share the same transaction manager. Outbox repository also requires active transaction and processing video with actual size.
implementation.processing_claims: Conditional claim increments persisted processing_attempts only on acquisition, at most VIDEO_QUEUE.MAX_ATTEMPTS=3. Busy duplicate does not consume budget. Heartbeat/retry release/terminal writes require current token and unexpired lease.
implementation.terminal_fencing: Finalization locks the video before checking live deadline, uses matching processing token, and atomically closes the outbox. Ready keys must match videos/<id>/attempts/<token>/playback.mp4 and thumbnail.jpg. Stale attempts cannot overwrite terminal results.
implementation.dispatch: Due, incomplete intents of processing videos only; pessimistic_write FOR UPDATE OF outbox with SKIP LOCKED and bounded batch. Lease/UUID token fence acknowledgments and releases. Successful dispatch records dispatched_at without completing the intent; due dispatched intents remain eligible for reconciliation. Fixed sanitized failure diagnostic.

real_database_proofs: Private cross-channel lookup returns null; ordinary reads exclude multipart upload id.

Forced real UNIQUE collision retries successfully and SELECT 1 remains usable in the surrounding transaction; bounded exhaustion also leaves that transaction usable; unrelated FK violation is not retried.
Concurrent upload, processing and dispatch claims each produce one winner; actual row held by another QueryRunner is skipped without blocking the dispatch batch.
Expired upload token fails completion/release; replacement claim reports required reconciliation and rejects old failure write.
Real division-by-zero SQL failure after actual outbox insertion rolls back processing transition, actual size and outbox together; retry succeeds.
Wrong size/channel and repeated/concurrent completion create no duplicate outbox or partial transition.
Only acquired processing attempts consume the persisted three-attempt budget; transient release leaves processing and open outbox.
Expired worker cannot heartbeat, release, publish ready or finish error, even before replacement; superseded token cannot overwrite the winning derived keys or error state.
Real SQL failure after terminal update and outbox completion rolls both back; missing intent also rolls terminal update back; retry safely finishes error.
Dispatch does not close intent; expired dispatcher is fenced; dispatched due intent can be reclaimed; terminal videos are excluded.

documentation.version_note: Upstream branch documentation cross-checked against installed TypeORM 0.3.28 declarations for setLock/setOnLocked and UpdateResult.affected. Avoided raw:any results; used IsNull/Not/In for nullable predicates. Container lacks rg; declaration check used grep fallback.

test_environment.concurrency: Within individual tests only; independent suites never run in parallel.

development_database.name: streamtube
development_database.comparison: SHA-256 of normalized pg_dump excluding comments/backslash directives

resolved_check_findings: Initial directed lint found unsafe any inferred by Function.bind in failure-injection test spies; spies now restore the public collaborator before invoking its real implementation, preserving real SQL failure and rollback assertions. No casts, lint suppression or reduced assertions.
limits: S3 confirmation/reconciliation, media processing and actual BullMQ delivery belong to later SIs; requiresReconciliation is an explicit contract for those callers.
No existing migrations or unrelated channel collision logic changed.
